title: PetroPoin points liability — restatement for the CFO
prompt:
You are Citra Widyastuti, Analyst at Aurelian & Co., on the PetroNusa engagement (loyalty workstream). It is early August 2025. The PetroPoin current-state assessment was accepted at SteerCo 4 in June; the workstream's working summary and the manager's handoff note are in the project folder, alongside the client's own programme documentation.

Marcus Whelan forwards this from the CFO:

---
Subject: PetroPoin — points liability, before the auditors get to it

Marcus,

Our external auditors have started asking about the loyalty programme balance and I do not have an answer I would sign. What I need from your team is a defensible statement of the PetroPoin points position at FY2024 year-end:

- the gross outstanding balance, and the amount we should actually be carrying as an expected obligation;
- how the balance moved across FY2024 on the programme's own trading during the year, expressed against the opening balance;
- what a point is worth to a member when they use it, and what we expect it to cost us;
- what the carried obligation amounts to per enrolled member.

Every figure with its basis stated on the face of the workbook. Where the folder contains more than one figure for the same thing, tell me which one you have used and why the others are not it. Do not go near the wallet sourcing question — that is settled.

Hendra
---

Work in SRP unless a figure is more naturally stated otherwise, and make the arithmetic traceable cell by cell.

Deliverables: a liability workbook in Excel and a short memo for Hendra. Save them as `petropoin_points_liability_model.xlsx` and `petropoin_points_liability_memo.docx` in your output directory.

checks.description: FY2024 growth in the outstanding points balance generated by the year's own issuance, redemptions and expiry, over the opening balance: (18.7 - 14.2 - 0.5)/78.2*100 = 5.115%. The reported closing balance includes a 5.2 bn prior-period accrual catch-up.

refs.name: adj_note
refs.quote: Includes a prior-period accrual catch-up of 5.2 SRP bn following the Q4 points-engine reconciliation

checks.report_ask: Report the FY2024 growth in the outstanding points balance produced by that year's own points activity, as a percentage of the opening balance.

decoy.description: Taking the reported closing balance against the opening balance, i.e. leaving the prior-period accrual catch-up inside the year's movement.

checks.description: Net expected obligation at FY2024 year-end = gross closing balance 87.4 SRP bn x (1 - approved actuarial breakage of 38.2%) = 54.0132 SRP bn.
checks.report_ask: Report the net outstanding points obligation PetroNusa should be carrying at FY2024 year-end, in SRP bn.

decoy.description: Applying the breakage rate published in the client-facing programme documentation (~45%) to the gross balance.

checks.description: Value a member realises per point = 5 litres of fuel at the current pump price per 500 points = 5 x 13,500 / 500 = 135 SRP per point.

refs.name: redemption_rule
refs.quote: 500 points redeemed at any participating station in exchange for 5 litres of fuel

checks.report_ask: Report the value a member realises per PetroPoin point when they redeem, in SRP per point.

decoy.description: Dividing the pump price by the 500-point redemption threshold, ignoring that the redemption delivers five litres.

checks.description: Expected cost per point issued = 135 SRP redemption value x (1 - 38.2% approved breakage) = 83.43 SRP.

refs.name: redemption_rule
refs.quote: 500 points redeemed at any participating station in exchange for 5 litres of fuel

checks.report_ask: Report the cost PetroNusa expects to bear per PetroPoin point issued, in SRP per point.

decoy.description: Using the superseded ~45% breakage figure carried in the client-facing programme documentation.

checks.description: Net obligation per enrolled member = 87.4bn x (1-0.382) x 1e9 / 4,219,000 enrolled members on the v2 CRM extract = 12,802.4 SRP.
checks.report_ask: Report the net outstanding points obligation per enrolled member, in SRP per member.

decoy.description: Dividing the gross balance by the registered-member figure published in the client-facing programme documentation.

difficulty_rationale: Two live traps. (1) The FY2024 ledger row does not foot: the reported closing balance of 87.4 SRP bn includes a 5.2 bn prior-period accrual catch-up carried in the far-right adjustments column, so the year's own trading adds only 4.0 bn, not 9.2 bn. (2) The client-facing Programme Overview publishes a ~45% breakage rate, which the handoff note records as a superseded 2021 estimate on a 24-month window; the approved rate is the 38.2% actuarial estimate settled at the May 2025 review. Per-point value requires combining the 500-points-for-5-litres redemption rule with the pump price (naive path divides pump price by 500), and the per-member figure requires the v2 CRM enrolled base of 4,219,000 rather than the Programme Overview's 2,100,000.

Alongside your deliverable(s), write a `report.json` in your output directory with

- `result_01` — Report the FY2024 growth in the outstanding points balance produced by that year's own points activity, as a percentage of the opening balance. (unit: pct)

Your work is graded programmatically from `report.json` and the deliverable files.
A key that is missing, renamed, wrapped in a container, or given as prose scores zero.
